records.description: City's Istanbul is the shopping centre in İçerenköy, Ataşehir, near Kozyatağı metro—not the similarly named mall in Nişantaşı. An April 2026 exchange on a gay cruising directory talks about the S1 and S3 levels, with one contributor describing the location favourably while also warning about cleaners and security. That's useful local knowledge, but nobody in those comments clearly describes an actual recent encounter. The shopping centre lists retail opening hours of roughly 10:00–22:00; those are not guaranteed toilet-access times. There's no reliable information about the crowd, a peak period or whether the reported areas remain accessible. This is a working shopping centre used by ordinary visitors, so discretion, consent and the operator's rules matter.

No reliable best time or crowd profile
records.address: İçerenköy, Kayışdağı Cd No 2/2, Ataşehir, Istanbul
records.opening_notes: Retail hours reported by mall operator: 10:00–22:00; not verified restroom hours.

records.description: The Westend City Center shopping mall in Budapest has been listed for years as a meeting place, especially around its men's toilets. The accounts don't agree on the exact part of the building: one guide mentions the level near Deichmann and an upper floor, while an older guide refers to a ground-floor facility near a fountain. Historic descriptions suggest daytime and lunchtime activity and a younger crowd, including mall workers, but they're not recent observations. In July 2026 someone said they were physically there and found nobody, while a March commenter recalled meetings without dating them. Westend is a managed shopping centre near Nyugati station, with cleaning staff and other shoppers. Check current facilities and don't rely on old reports of openings between cubicles.
blockers: Young crowd and lunchtime claims are historical, not verified in 2026
records.tags: Shopping Centre, Public Restroom, Daytime, Historical Reports
records.opening_notes: Access follows shopping-centre management and individual restroom opening; directory 'all day' is not official.

records.description: Budapest Airport appears in a cruising directory, but the listing is too vague to direct anyone to a genuine meeting place. The airport has more than one terminal area, with passenger-only sections after security screening. July 2026 comments include a general favourable remark and a question about a boarding-gate toilet; neither identifies a specific facility or documents an encounter. There is no reliable indication of times, types of visitors or whether the mentioned area can lawfully be accessed without a ticket. Don't travel to the airport expecting a publicly accessible cruising venue based on this entry. Until a specific location and recent firsthand account can be established, it shouldn't appear as a live Backroom cruising spot.
blockers: No confirmed recent encounter or crowd pattern
records.opening_notes: Terminal and security-controlled toilet access varies by passenger status; not an open cruising venue.

records.description: This old cruising entry refers to a public toilet around Piața Unirii in central Bucharest, near the exit towards the former Hotel Horoscope. The metro operator lists passenger toilets at Piața Unirii, but that doesn't confirm the exact cubicle or access point described by contributors. Reports disagree over whether the relevant fixture was closed or covered: a March 2025 visitor mentioned repairs, while another claimed activity in July 2025. The only newer April 2026 message is a question asking whether anyone would be around soon, not an account of meeting someone. No dependable best times, crowd or current opening details are known. Given the conflicting closure reports, treat this as unverified rather than a dependable place to go.
blockers: Last positive firsthand claim July 2025, outside 12-month window
2026 post is an invitation, not an encounter
records.opening_notes: Metro passenger toilets, subject to operator hours and current maintenance.

records.description: The restroom at Bucharest's Piața Victoriei metro station has a longstanding cruising-directory listing, originally suggesting lunchtime or after 18:00. The listing identifies the Lascăr Catargiu side of the station, but this is a public passenger facility, not a managed gay venue. The most specific firsthand encounter report was posted on 5 November 2025, just outside the current twelve-month period. A visitor on 17 November 2025 found it empty and said a reported opening between stalls had been covered; another comment said the area might still be active without dating an encounter. February–April 2026 posts are mostly questions and arrangements. Neither the peak hours nor the original layout can be considered current, so this one stays on hold.
